body:
I've started a jekyll website based with the content of @bobylito's documentation here: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/tree/feature/new-site/site

We'll probably host it on `https://community.algolia.com/instant-search/` or something similar.

Why Jekyll?

* built-in search :) (cc @pixelastic)
* gh-pages compliant
* markdown <3
* ease of development with SASS, live-reload & templates
